kitDescription: Soline: Frost Ticket is a Water SG Burst-I Supporter who is a pure healer/enabler with no offensive kit lines — her only damage is ordinary shotgun spray. At battle start and each time she casts her own Burst she hands every ally a 'ticket' (capped at 2), and each ticket raises every ally's Max HP by 10% of Soline's own Max HP. Whenever the team enters Full Burst she cuts everyone's Burst-Skill cooldown by 7.48 seconds (a real team-rotation accelerator) and clears the internal 'First Train Discount' status. If any squad member drops below 15% HP she pours out an emergency heal for 12.27% of her Max HP, spending one of that ally's tickets. Her Burst itself heals the whole squad for 32.26% of her Max HP, which is what fires teammates' on-recovery damage buffs.

skill1.explanation: The ticket currency has no engine primitive; the faithful AVAILABLE encoding is the derived steady-state flat passive. She reaches cap at her first burst and never consumes under scope-lock. Ramp collapse is a documented flag, not a gotcha.

verdictRationale: GO. Every kit line is FAITHFUL (ticket casterMaxHpPct grant, FB-enter burstCdr 7.48, burst heal on burstCast) or a documented UNMODELED gap (S1 discount-removal, the whole S2 block, S2 First Train Discount) — faithfulness 1.0, zero REAL-GOTCHAs. Both cross-family re-derivations converge: fable's pre-op S2b agrees on all four load-bearing lines and both trigger identities (casterMaxHpPct not targetMaxHpPct; burstCdr on fullBurstEnter not oncePerBattle/burstCast; heal on burstCast not fullBurstEnter), and opus's blind S6 override reproduces the driver's encoding line-for-line (only cosmetic maxStacks:2 / ticks:1 diffs). The S5 blind test run is a DOCUMENTED harness artifact (suite error: missing vitest imports + `ov.blocks` no-op helpers + a `casterMaxHpPct` filter that never matches the engine's emitted `maxHpFlat` stat — identical class to the takina/tove `o.blocks` no-op), not an override divergence; convergence is carried by the fixture-independent spec table + S6, and the driver's own S2d matrix shows all 6 FAITHFUL pins GREEN vs shipped and all 5 named counterfactuals RED (no vacuous test). The three engine FACTs hold: the ally Max-HP grant is offensively inert (kept per hard rule 3 for a future consumer, not a silent drop), the S2 HP<15% heal is STRUCTURALLY unreachable in v1 (not measurement-gated — correctly unmodeled rather than fabricated), and the burstCdr is a real cadence lever (6 FBs vs 5). Two same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check, neither GO-blocking and both prose-faithful: (1) the burstCdr trigger identity fullBurstEnter-vs-burstCast is NOT behaviorally discriminable for a Burst-I unit whose own cast opens every chain (same firing count, ~82 frames apart) — the driver picked fullBurstEnter on the prose wording ('when entering Full Burst') corroborated by fable; (2) the ticket steady-state (flat casterMaxHpPct 20) collapses the 10%->20% ramp, a documented flag that moves zero damage because the grant is inert. Magnitudes (10%, 7.48s, 12.27%, 32.26%, cap 2) are all literal DATAMINED level-10 prose values and out of scope. The shipped override is faithful — GO.
